title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Repository Contract Audit — message 3

metadata.content:
Resumed. Phase 50 closure audit is not yet closed.
The additional repository inspection found CanonicalKnowledgeQueryService is an unrestricted façade over the authoritative CanonicalKnowledgeStore: get(), list(), findByType(), search(), and size() all expose the underlying store directly.  However, repository usage shows this query service is currently instantiated only inside KnowledgePlatform; the active reasoning consumers we already repaired receive their governed views separately.
The remaining raw canonical access found in registerOrganizationalMemoryAdaptationRoutes is correctly classified as a governance/write path: it requires a canonical package, resolves its canonicalization IDs, and passes those authoritative items into adaptAndPersist(). It must remain authoritative rather than being Genesis-filtered.
Likewise, KnowledgeAutomation.completeEngineeringPhase() calls the Organizational Memory pipeline, but that pipeline delegates to registered providers. Runtime now registers the Genesis-governed memory provider, so this read path inherits the Phase 42 gate rather than bypassing it.
Current Phase 50 classification is therefore:
ACTIVE READS
KnowledgeContextBuilder canonical       → Genesis governed
KnowledgeContextBuilder memory          → governed registered provider
Chief-Agent canonical                   → Genesis governed
Chief-Agent memory                      → Genesis governed
Education                               → Genesis governed
Knowledge Operations canonical metrics  → Genesis governed
Learning Builder projection             → authoritative Runtime response

AUTHORITATIVE / WRITE / GOVERNANCE
KnowledgePlatform.store                 → intentionally authoritative
CanonicalKnowledgeQueryService          → authoritative platform façade
promotion/canonical review              → authoritative
organizational-memory adaptation        → authoritative
historical reconstruction/lineage       → authoritative

PERSISTED HISTORY
suppressed ADR canonicals               → retained
derived Organizational Memory           → retained
active consumption                      → suppressed
The remaining closure task is a final search for direct consumers of KnowledgePlatform.list()/search() and CanonicalKnowledgeQueryService outside the already-governed composition. If none exist, M50 can be certified closed without another production patch.
